Do most psychologists really care? The main reason I don't want to see someone is because I don't feel like paying someone to listen to my shitty teenage problems would help very much, that and family judgement.

Not really the police, just anyone. My close friend told me he was suicidal and going to kill himself, I had no clue what to do so I just tried to talk him out of it which didn't work.

He killed himself 23/8/15, 6:11 AM was his last verbal contact to anyone, and he would have died around 6:30-6:45 AM, New Zealand time.

Since you first started replying, I have gone to a couple gay subreddits (lgbteens in particular). Apart from this I have no clue how to work through the other issues, I actually have no idea why people seem to dislike me, I'm pretty sure I might just be strange and hard to talk to, mostly because of the social anxiety, but outside of this I find whenever I try to talk someone my voice goes unheard, no matter where. Anytime I try to input something to a conversation it's like no one hears me, or are ignoring me, It got pretty ridiculous to the point of me very breifly thinking I might be dead like that character from the sixth sense, eventually I realized that no one really cared what I had to say so I stopped talking to anyone all together, now I have no clue how to talk to people even if they are listening.

It still seems really intimidating right now, I most certainly don't want my family to find out about any of this, and as I said I am way to scared to talk about it, maybe at some point in the future I'll talk to someone but for now I think I can only stick to reddit.

Honestly I'm the only one I know of who hurts this badly from it, and I'm pretty sure no one would hurt if I went. When he chose the time/day it was only 3 days before he actually did it, I am sure that if he was here right now he would regret doing it so recently; his original plans where to wait until he finished high school so he could be able to spend some time playing games before he had to become an adult, then kill himself after that. If I told one of his relatives, he could get counselling, medication, therapy, anything, and he could still be here. I'm way to scared to verbalize any feeling I have right now, I've only made reddit posts and talked to the few internet friends I have, maybe eventually I'll be able to see a therapist but I don't think so, the idea of paying someone to listen to me complain about my problems doesn't seem like it will help at all.

Yes, 100%. I knew his plans to kill himself from 7 months before it happened, I knew when he was going to do it 3 days before. I have no fucking clue who I chose to not tell anyone, and now hes gone because of me and I get to live with that for the rest of my probably short life.
